name: No-Show Recovery
outcome: Make missed appointments visible and help the clinic offer appropriate rescheduling follow-up.
outputs: Reschedule request or confirmed appointment outcome
guardrails: Do not assume a no-show from missing data.
Do not pressure or shame patients.
A reschedule is not a confirmed booking until the authoritative calendar confirms it.
activation_requirements: Clinic-approved, respectful follow-up timing and messaging.
Staff can pause automation, correct status, and take over.
